name: Audio Input
summary: Loads or uploads an audio file into the workflow. Stores duration, format (MIME type), and base64-encoded audio data.

inputs.description: Optional upstream audio connection (for audio processing chains)

outputs.description: The audio file as base64 data URL with metadata (filename, duration, MIME format)

executionNotes: Accepts uploaded audio files or audio from upstream nodes. Stores the audio as a data URL (base64-encoded) along with filename, duration in seconds, and MIME format (e.g., 'audio/mp3', 'audio/wav').

exampleConnections.scenario: Use uploaded audio as input for audio processing or transformation via Wavespeed API
